title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Explore the unique rituals and long-standing traditions that define the student experience at Bryan College of Health Sciences, from historic nursing ceremonies to modern campus celebrations.

cards.title: The Nursing Pinning Ceremony
cards.subtitle: A Rite of Passage Since 1926
cards.notes: Graduating nurses receive a unique Bryan College pin, a tradition dating back to the school's founding in 1926 to mark the transition to professional practice.
cards.short_summary: A historic ceremony where nursing graduates receive their school-specific pins.
cards.evidence_claim: The nursing pinning ceremony is a special tradition at Bryan College of Health Sciences that marks the transition from student to professional nurse.
cards.source_title: Student Life - Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Typically held in May and December for graduating nursing cohorts.

cards.title: Blue Healer Day
cards.subtitle: Campus Spirit and Recruitment
cards.notes: Prospective and current students gather for hands-on activities and tours, celebrating the 'Blue Healer' mascot and college community.
cards.short_summary: An interactive event for prospective students to experience the 'Blue Healer' culture.
cards.evidence_claim: Blue Healer Day provides students the opportunity to explore health care programs through hands-on activities and campus tours.
cards.source_title: Blue Healer Day - Lincoln - Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Scheduled recruitment events throughout the academic year.

cards.title: The White Coat Ceremony
cards.subtitle: Commitment to Compassionate Care
cards.notes: Students in various health programs receive their first white coats and recite a professional oath to symbolize their entry into clinical practice.
cards.short_summary: A formal ceremony welcoming students into the healthcare profession with their first white coats.
cards.evidence_claim: Bryan College of Health Sciences holds white coat ceremonies for students transitioning into clinical training.
cards.source_title: History | Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Held annually for incoming clinical students.

cards.title: Blue Mondays
cards.subtitle: Weekly School Spirit
cards.notes: Students and faculty are encouraged to wear blue every Monday to show school pride and unity across the Lincoln and Hastings campuses.
cards.short_summary: A weekly tradition of wearing school colors to foster campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: The college promotes 'On Mondays we wear blue' as part of its College Colors Day and weekly spirit initiatives.
cards.source_title: On Mondays we wear blue - Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Occurs every Monday during the academic semester.

cards.title: Nightingale Lamp Lighting
cards.subtitle: The Lamp of Learning
cards.notes: During pinning, students participate in a symbolic lamp lighting, honoring Florence Nightingale's legacy of service and vigilance in nursing.
cards.short_summary: A symbolic lighting of lamps or candles representing the transfer of nursing knowledge.
cards.evidence_claim: The lamp lighting is a core component of the nursing pinning ceremony at Bryan College of Health Sciences.
cards.source_title: Bryan College of Health Sciences Nurse Pinning Ceremony | 2021
cards.access_notes: Part of the formal pinning ceremony for nursing graduates.

cards.title: Alumni & Family Celebration
cards.subtitle: Annual Fall Gathering
cards.notes: A multi-day event in September featuring reunions, campus tours, and social activities for the entire Bryan College community.
cards.short_summary: An annual fall weekend dedicated to connecting alumni, current students, and their families.
cards.evidence_claim: The Alumni, Student and Family Celebration is a recurring fall event held at the Lincoln campus.
cards.source_title: Alumni, Student and Family Weekend - Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Typically held over a weekend in early September.

cards.title: Fairview Mansion Heritage
cards.subtitle: The Original Student Dormitory
cards.notes: Students often visit the historic Fairview Mansion, the former home of William Jennings Bryan, which served as the college's first dormitory.
cards.short_summary: A tradition of visiting the historic home that housed the first nursing students in 1926.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairview became the student dormitory when the Bryan School of Nursing opened in 1926.
cards.source_title: Teaching the Next Generation of Caregivers - Bryan Health
cards.access_notes: The mansion is located on the Bryan East Campus and is open for scheduled historical tours.

cards.title: The Cadaver Lab Tradition
cards.subtitle: Foundational Health Science
cards.notes: A defining academic rite for undergraduates, Bryan is one of the few colleges in the region providing direct cadaver access to first-year students.
cards.short_summary: A rigorous and unique hands-on learning tradition for health science students.
cards.evidence_claim: Bryan College of Health Sciences offers students access to platinate specimens and cadaver labs as part of their hands-on learning.
cards.source_title: About BCHS - Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Access is restricted to students enrolled in specific anatomy and science courses.

cards.title: St. Mark's Commencement
cards.subtitle: A Traditional Graduation Venue
cards.notes: Graduation ceremonies are traditionally held at St. Mark's United Methodist Church, maintaining a long-standing link to the local community.
cards.short_summary: The traditional site for Bryan College of Health Sciences graduation exercises.
cards.evidence_claim: Graduation for the BCHS Lincoln Campus is held at St. Mark's United Methodist Church.
cards.source_title: Graduation Ceremony - Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Ceremonies typically occur in May and December.

cards.title: The Uniform Legacy
cards.subtitle: Visual History of Nursing
cards.notes: The college maintains a display of historic nursing uniforms and artifacts, allowing students to see the evolution of their profession since 1926.
cards.short_summary: A permanent display of historic nursing attire and medical equipment in the college halls.
cards.evidence_claim: Old nursing uniforms, equipment, and other artifacts adorn the walls of the modern college facility to remind students of their legacy.
cards.source_title: Teaching the Next Generation of Caregivers - Bryan Health
cards.access_notes: Located in the hallways of the main college building, accessible during campus hours.
